DESCRIPTIO: 1987-04-12: Seepage bog bayhead; pitcher plants at head of spring from seepage along hillside. Pine trees nearby tree cover, bog area open and exposed to direct sunlight, eventually forms small trickle stream with titi, wax myrtle (U87DAI01FLUS).
